title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 7: the families of Issachar, Benjamin, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim and Asher.

questions.text: Which sons of Issachar are listed in verse 1?
questions.explanation: The sons of Issachar were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

questions.text: Why were there so many bands of the army in Issachar's families?
questions.explanation: With them were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand, for they had many wives and sons.

answers.text: They had many wives and sons
They lived in many walled cities

questions.text: Who are named as the sons of Benjamin in verse 6?
questions.explanation: The sons of Benjamin were Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore; she also bore Machir the father of Gilead.

questions.text: According to verse 15, who had daughters?
questions.explanation: The name of the second was Zelophehad, and Zelophehad had daughters.

questions.text: Why did the men of Gath kill Ezer and Elead?
questions.explanation: The men of Gath killed them because they came down to take away their livestock.

answers.text: They came down to take away their livestock
They had built an altar to Dagon
They had taken wives from Gath

questions.text: Why did Ephraim name his son Beriah?
questions.explanation: Ephraim's wife bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

answers.text: Because he was born in Bethel
Because he was born in a time of peace
Because there was trouble with his house

questions.text: What did Ephraim's daughter Sheerah build?
questions.explanation: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

answers.text: Bethel and its towns, and Naaran
Lower and upper Beth Horon, and Uzzen Sheerah
Shechem and Gezer with their towns

questions.text: Whose son was Joshua, at the end of Ephraim's line?
questions.explanation: The line of Ephraim ends with Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

questions.text: How many of Asher's descendants were listed by genealogy for service in war?
questions.explanation: The number of the children of Asher listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
